title: Ravik statement on rail capacity for Orvan grain

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: Rail movements through the Ravik Rail Link have risen since the Orvan corridor ended.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rail movements through the Ravik Rail Link have risen since the Orvan corridor ended.

facts.subject: Rail capacity booking
facts.statement: The government says shippers should book rail capacity early.

source_ref.text_snippet: The government says shippers should book rail capacity early.

facts.subject: Booking process for buyers
facts.statement: Buyers who need a booking have been told to approach the link directly.

facts.subject: Reassurance to buyers
facts.statement: The minister's office says the purpose was to reassure buyers that a land route exists.

facts.subject: Details on rail capacity
facts.statement: It is short on detail: it does not give the volume moved, the share of the lost trade carried, or the tariff charged.
